overview: A Thai-language credit-sales ledger where a shop manager tracks customers, products, invoices, payments, and debts, while customers sign in to view their own records and upload bank-transfer proof.
features: Manager dashboard for customers, products, invoices, payments, and debts
Customer portal showing only that customer's own invoices, debts, payments, and receipts
Create invoices from a product catalog with automatic THB totals
Record manual payments and track outstanding balances per customer
Customers upload bank-transfer proof against the shop's bank details
Manager approves or rejects uploaded proofs and payment status updates
Thai-layout invoice, receipt, and debt-notice documents with print and save-as-PDF
In-app notifications for both manager and customers
Shop profile and bank details settings
